title: What tools do you have for sending files

messages.content: what tools do you have for sending files.

Here's the rundown:

## Direct file delivery to you

| Tool | What it does | Limit |
|------|-------------|-------|
| **`send_file`** | Sends any file (PDF, GIF, MP3, code, anything) as an attachment in this conversation — works in-app, WhatsApp, and Telegram | 50 MB |
| **`add_to_chat`** | Shows the last generated meme/GIF inline in chat | — |

## Platform-specific

| Tool | Channel | Type |
|------|---------|------|
| `whatsapp_send_image` | WhatsApp | Image (base64) |
| `whatsapp_send_document` | WhatsApp | Any file (base64) |
| `whatsapp_send_audio` | WhatsApp | Voice note (base64) |
| `telegram_send_photo` | Telegram | Image |
| `telegram_send_document` | Telegram | Any file (50 MB) |
| `telegram_send_video` | Telegram | Video |
| `telegram_send_audio` | Telegram | Audio (music player) |

## Cloud upload

| Tool | Service |
|------|---------|
| `google_drive_upload` | Uploads a file to your Google Drive |

## Auto-attached

Some tools attach their output automatically — like `pdf_create`, `document_create`, `spreadsheet_create`, `meme_generate`, `voice_generate`, and `ffmpeg_run` — so you don't need to call `send_file` after them.

The main one you'll use is **`send_file`** — one call, any file type, delivered to whatever channel you're talking to me on. 🐟

The user is asking about what tools I have for sending files. Let me look through the tools I have available and identify the ones related to sending files.

From my tools list, here are the file-sending tools:

1. **send_file** - Deliver a file to the user as a downloadable attachment in the conversation. Works for ANY file type. Up to 50 MB.

2. **whatsapp_send_image** - Send an image to a WhatsApp JID (base64)
3. **whatsapp_send_document** - Send a file/document to a WhatsApp JID (base64)
4. **whatsapp_send_audio** - Send a voice note to a WhatsApp JID (base64)

5. **telegram_send_photo** - Send an image to Telegram
6. **telegram_send_document** - Send any file to Telegram
7. **telegram_send_video** - Send a video to Telegram
8. **telegram_send_audio** - Send an audio to Telegram

9. **google_drive_upload** - Upload a file to Google Drive

And some tools also surface files as attachments automatically (pdf_create, document_create, etc.)
